asset_heavy.reason: Designs, builds and operates multi-orbit satellite constellation and ground infrastructure requiring heavy ongoing capital investment.

big_ticket.reason: Mostly monthly connectivity subscriptions for homes, airlines, maritime; small frequent payments, though some government terminals and satellites are large.

cyclical_demand.reason: Connectivity subscriptions for homes, airlines, ships and defense are sticky and mission-critical, not easily cut in a downturn.

large_customers.reason: Governments, militaries, airlines and maritime fleets are major customers, alongside consumer broadband; larger part is enterprise and government.

notes: Mixed business: consumer home satellite internet alongside larger government and commercial connectivity (Inmarsat, in-flight, defense).

offers_products.reason: Sells satellite terminals, modems, and defense communications equipment, and designs satellites, alongside connectivity.

offers_services.reason: Main offering is satellite internet and connectivity services for homes, airlines, ships, and militaries.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from satellite network and technology, not staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Monthly home internet plans, in-flight and maritime connectivity subscriptions and multi-year service contracts drive most revenue.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells unlimited home satellite internet plans to households with professional installation.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to airlines, shipping firms, enterprises, governments and militaries, including WildBlue Business Solutions for utilities.
